[Act: limitation
 Chapter: First Division · Part II · Suits Relating to Contracts
 Section: 16::Three years.
]


For the price of goods sold and delivered to be paid for by a bill of exchange, no such bill being given.
Period of limitationThree years.
Time from which period begins to runWhen the period of the proposed bill elapses.
